title: I’m so proud! MarijuanaNews Got Hacked!

content_html_sanitized:
After all these years of being ignored by all the very, very best people, someone at least cares enough to do their very worst.

 

Obviously, if you’re reading this we are back online. (Thanks Jay!)

But this is just the world we live in.

 

Back in 1997, shortly after I began MarijuanaNews, I posted a critique of an exceptionally dishonest article that had been published in a major newspaper. A few days later, I got one of my first emails from the paper’s legal department telling me that I was violating their copyright, etc, etc and I should take it down. Or else…

 

I responded by telling them that I would not let them hide their lies behind a copyright claim, so please sue me!

 

I never heard from them again, but they didn’t stop lying.

 

Of course, no one really wants to get hacked, and it is morally wrong, even more so than hiding behind a copyright. It isn’t as though Prohibitionists don’t get their views published. This just shows how little confidence they have in their arguments.
